note: Eval per product repo for cloud-kit/hooks/eval-gate.py. Repo = basename of the git origin URL. 'paths' is a regex searched in each changed path; the first eval that matches covers the file, else 'default' (null = no eval covers it: the PR says 'Eval: none' and why). 'ran' is a regex: a Bash command matching it counts as a run of that eval. 'live' runs only where vault exists; live evals never use OpenRouter (skill llm-provider-chain). Keep in sync with the eval table in skills/llm-provider-chain/SKILL.md (tests/hooks/test_eval_gate.py checks).

evals.name: qualify
evals.offline: PYTHONPATH=. uv run python -m evals.m3 qualify
evals.live: vault run --keys BEDROCK_API_KEY,GROQ_API_KEY,ANTHROPIC_API_KEY -- env PYTHONPATH=. uv run python -m evals.m3 qualify --live
